title: AION 2 Codes: Global Rewards and How to Redeem
description: Check the confirmed Global coupon rewards, redemption steps, account limit, and fixes. Keep inbox gifts, Twitch Drops, and regional coupons separate.
summary: Redeem the confirmed Global coupon through the correct menu and check its account limit, rewards, and common errors.

toc.title: What the Global coupon gives you
Claim the other launch rewards separately

topic.alt: NC's Global coupon banner showing the three announced reward icons.
topic.caption: Official reward preview for the confirmed Global coupon. The exact item names, quantities, and account limit are explained in this section.

workflow.title: Choose the correct reward route
workflow.caption: A coupon, an inbox gift, and a Twitch Drop have separate claiming methods.

steps.label: Identify the reward
steps.description: Check whether the announcement describes a coupon, an inbox gift, or a Twitch Drop.

steps.label: Open its claim entry
steps.description: Use Enter Coupon for the code, the in-game inbox for the gift, or Twitch inventory for a Drop.

steps.label: Check the recipient
steps.description: Use your Global playing account. The coupon allowance is one redemption per account across all servers.

steps.label: Read the result
steps.description: Check the client or Twitch claim result before repeating the action; keep the exact error if help is needed.
